fichas.title: Daylight: Insolation and Sun-Path Diagrams
fichas.summary: Explains how sun position, seasonal daylight and shadowing affect building elevations and sides. Sun-path diagrams show the winter-solstice path for latitude 51.5° north and the sun’s midday positions on significant dates. A shadow-construction method transfers azimuth and solar altitude information between plan and elevation. Separate diagrams illustrate sunshine and shadow conditions at the summer solstice, equinox and winter solstice.
uses: Assess seasonal sunshine and shadow on building sides
Determine shadow boundaries for a chosen time and date using plan and elevation
